overview: The Medford City Council approved funding for contamination testing at Riverbend Park, granted a conditional extended hours permit for a local pizzeria, and passed a resolution requesting $1 million in the municipal budget for road repaving. The Council also referred the Mayor's proposed Fiscal Year 2018 budget and related capital transfers to the Committee of the Whole.

items.title: Riverbend Park Contamination LSP Services Funding
items.summary: Approved an appropriation of $49,000 in certified free cash for environmental testing and Licensed Site Professional services to assess soil lead and arsenic contamination at Riverbend Park.

items.title: Residential Neighborhood Business Complaint
items.summary: Referred a resident petition regarding an unpermitted landscaping business operating at 1 Clematis Road to the building inspector and Board of Health for inspection and enforcement.

items.title: Boston Avenue and Harvard Street Construction Disruption
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting that the city engineer, state agencies, and developers coordinate traffic management plans and provide clear timelines to mitigate local business disruption from ongoing construction.

items.title: Special Permit for Annie's Pizzeria Extended Hours
items.summary: Approved a special permit for Annie's Pizzeria at 213 Middlesex Avenue to extend hours until midnight Wednesday through Saturday, subject to a 90-day review before potential further extension.

items.title: Road Audit and Infrastructure Paving Funding Resolution
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting a comprehensive citywide road condition audit and recommending that the Mayor add $1 million to the FY2018 budget dedicated to street repaving.

items.title: C-Click-Fix Paper Withdrawal
items.summary: Withdrawn by the sponsor following scheduling of a meeting with the administration's council liaison.

items.title: Fiscal Year 2018 Budget Submission
items.summary: Tabled the Mayor's proposed FY 2018 municipal and school budgets totaling $161,117,437 to the budget review process.

items.title: Cemetery Department Appropriations
items.summary: Referred requests to appropriate $188,400 from sale of grave lots and $161,861 for care to the Committee of the Whole.

items.title: Water Main Leak Detection System Transfer
items.summary: Referred a proposed $900,000 transfer from water retained earnings to purchase an acoustic water main leak detection system to the Committee of the Whole.
